outputs.explanation: Spatial transcriptomic cluster map overlaid on a tissue section image; this is a micrograph-based spatial visualization, not a plot of averaged data, so individual data point overlay does not apply.
H&E histology images with manual region annotations; these are micrographs, not summary plots of averaged data.

H&E image and spatial gene-expression maps overlaid on tissue sections; these are micrograph-based spatial visualizations of expression per spot, not averaged summary plots requiring individual point overlay.
GSEA enrichment plots are line plots showing a running enrichment score; line plots are exempt from requiring individual data point overlay as this would make them unreadable.

Bar graph shows log2 fold-change values (with associated p-values) derived from differential expression testing (Wilcoxon rank-sum, Bonferroni-corrected) across thousands of spatial transcriptomic spots per condition. Each bar represents a single computed statistic rather than a mean of a small number of replicate samples, so overlaying individual data points is not meaningful or feasible here.
